title: Apple proposes online reinforcement learning framework for UI navigation
excerpt: The framework trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications using a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model.
bodyHtml:
Apple published research on November 2, 2026, detailing an online reinforcement learning framework that trains user interface navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. According to the source, vision-language models have high inference costs that prohibit everyday use, while smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning or offline reinforcement learning memorize static trajectories and fail to recover from errors.

The proposed framework decouples the agent into a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. An LLM-as-a-Judge provides reward signals combining step-level feedback with a terminal reward for task completion. The framework optimizes the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization with step-level advantage estimation, alongside a neighbor-conditioned value estimation method called GiGPPO.

Evaluations on benchmarks such as UINavBench, iOSWorld, and AndroidWorld showed that the online reinforcement learning trained agents outperformed supervised fine-tuning and terminal-only baselines. The research states that 8B reinforcement learning agents achieved nearly a sevenfold improvement over the supervised fine-tuning baseline in out-of-distribution generalization to Android environments.
topic: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live iOS Apps
